provenance.prompt: Genre: folk adventure video game soundtrack, acoustic and warm. BPM: 88. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals. Setting: Pine Hollow, a misty pine forest at dawn - wonder first, quiet adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a gentle fiddle and tin whistle melody over fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a soft marimba; an upright bass and a steady groove of bodhran, cajon and shaker run under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: natural wooden-room sound.

Genre: video game main title theme, folk adventure in the spirit of Sea of Thieves. BPM: 96. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals. The main theme of Wildshard, a world that arrives one chunk at a time - wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a memorable, hummable fiddle melody introduced over fingerpicked guitar, then the full band - accordion, tin whistle, strummed guitars, marimba, upright bass and a driving frame drum and cajon groove; it builds to a rousing climax and ends on a resolved final chord. Production: warm, natural room sound.
